name: workmatch
description: A role-based freelance and job listing marketplace. Clients post jobs, freelancers pitch with proposals, and payment runs through Stripe Checkout, all managed from one dashboard.

paragraphs: A role-based freelance and job listing marketplace. Clients post jobs, freelancers pitch with proposals, and payment runs through Stripe Checkout, all managed from one dashboard.
Live Demo · Backend Repo · API Docs · Report a Bug
WorkMatch is the frontend of a full-stack freelance marketplace. It covers the complete hiring loop:
features: A client posts a job with a budget, deadline, required skills and experience level.
Freelancers browse open jobs and submit proposals with a price, timeline and approach.
The client reviews proposals and accepts one, which redirects them to Stripe Checkout.
Once payment clears, a contract goes live. When the work is delivered, the contract is marked complete.
An admin oversees the platform: user management, platform stats and a full audit trail.
